promotion_requirements: Primary CRPS improvement with95percent paired GW-block interval strictly below0

interpretation: Research acceptance gates only; no automatic production switch
uncertainty: Use whole-GW paired resampling; small samples are labelled inconclusive
frozen_comparisons: Participation and90-minute Brier as secondary diagnostics
Minute MAE descriptive only; not the optimisation target for an expected-value forecast
Count and timing diagnostics; no new coefficient selection on evaluation rounds
next_steps: Run daily paired predeadline forecasts using the frozen candidate and exact source linkage
Score only officially final checked rounds and retain source/publication clocks
Apply the frozen minimum-cohort and proper-score review protocol; never auto-activate
capture_strategy: Independent daily GitHub job reads linked original source/forecast artifacts and requires exact reference-minute marginal parity; the optional publisher hook is not installed
